why: The 2026-11-16 review found that the loader inside an installed hijacked package exits 0, because the walk never enters node_modules (ADR-0025). With no lockfile there was nothing else to read. The installed package's own package.json says which release it is, and that file is read by name for each listed package; the release is the proof, so the loader file itself stays unread and the prune is unchanged (ADR-0063).

findings.match: hijacked release of a real package installed
